_comment: Initial state of the planet. BINDING RULE: the planet starts completely empty - no settlements, no cities, no NPC-only places. Every settlement is founded by a human player. See docs/WORLD_DESIGN.md section 1.

planet._comment: Nature only. The planet is generated ONCE from this seed (scripts/geography/planet_generator.gd) and baked into data/world/planet/. Changing seed or generator requires re-baking and migrating stored settlement positions.
